name: Saffron the Tawny Cat
blurb: Saffron, a tawny-gold shorthair with a cream chin, deep gold eyes and a dark tip on her tail, sunbathes on the warm garden steps.
look: A normal four-legged tawny-gold shorthair house cat with a cream chin and underside, a dark tail tip and gold eyes. It wears nothing.

name: Sorrel the Sand-Gold Cat

look: A normal four-legged sleek, short-coated sand-gold house cat with a pale cream belly, dark-backed ears and hazel-gold eyes. It wears nothing.

look: A normal four-legged bronze-gold longhaired house cat with a thick neck ruff and faint tabby bands on the tail. It wears nothing.
